rationale: The Dawn branch of adapter_info() hardcoded the adapter identity: name was assembled as "Native Dawn Adapter (<backend>)", description mirrored it, and vendor was the literal string "Dawn". It never read dawn_info.device, .vendor or .description, so the reported identity described the backend rather than the driver. The wgpu-native branch in the same file already reads those fields with empty-value fallbacks, so this was a fix that reached one of two parallel paths. It matters to Pulp specifically: android_gpu_adapter_identity() feeds exactly these fields to the Android Vulkan driver blocklist, which therefore could never match a real driver. This mirrors the existing sibling implementation rather than introducing a new mechanism, and there is no named immutable Vellum framework commit to backport, so it is dispositioned pulp-only as Pulp host-integration work.
tests: GpuSurface adapter_info reports the driver's own identity
